framings.label: Historical origins explainer
framings.description: Posts explain how Armistice Day on Nov. 11 after World War I became Veterans Day, often clarifying how it differs from Memorial Day.

framings.label: Practical logistics and consumer deals
framings.description: Posts treat the day as a practical matter, listing what is open or closed, who gets time off, and where to find free meals and discounts.

framings.label: Gratitude and honoring service
framings.description: Posts use tribute language such as thank-you messages and remembrance of sacrifice to honor all who served and what freedom costs.

framings.label: Local ceremonies and community events
framings.description: Posts announce or cover parades, flyovers, cemetery ceremonies, school projects and institutional tributes in specific places.

framings.label: Peace, loss and political context
framings.description: Posts connect the day to peace advocacy, grief over war deaths, or national leaders' remarks, framing it through current conflict and politics.
